answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 306 Country: United Kingdom Title: In one of the fatwas issued on this site, regarding internet forums it mentions that if there is an online discussion and there is a female at other end, as long as there is no voice or picture, it is ok. Does this include discussions on msn etc when they are strictly to do with deeni matters. Question: Assalamualaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu, In one of the fatwas issued on this site, regarding internet forums it mentions that if there is an online discussion and there is a female at other end, as long as there is no voice or picture, it is ok. Does this include discussions on msn etc when they are strictly to do with deeni matters. I do not search any way in which this can be allowed but just curious. Jazakumullahu Khair for your time. Answer ID: 306 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 325=318/N) Yes, one can have discussion in this way by writing. And, if there is no woman at the other end then one can talk at permissible topics as on phones and mobiles. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
